correctness.rationale: Exact existence and centering follow from positive definiteness of \(I+tL\). The derivative of the normalized adjacency quadratic quotient has sign equal to the integer polynomial \(N'B-NB'\). A dependency-free exact exhaustive certificate covers every one of 558 labeled connected graph/nonconstant binary source combinations of order 2–4, has nonnegative derivative-numerator coefficients except precisely 24 path end-block cases, and verifies closed Moran and Geary formulas. The exceptional derivative has exactly one positive zero \((1+\sqrt{5})/4\). No finite grid is extrapolated to larger graphs.

value.rationale: The sharp minimum-size and source-pattern classification locates precisely when increasing physically homogeneous dispersal stops raising the conventional globally normalized adjacency autocorrelation. This is a natural structural boundary to an ecological smoothing intuition, not an arbitrary selected numerical slice; the exact critical ratio is forced by the simplest binary habitat step profile. The opposite Geary movement demonstrates index-sensitive interpretation. Claims of quantitative empirical impact or general graph theorems are expressly excluded.
